newsitem.title: UK: Toy Story figure Buzz Lightyear sold out in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Toy Story figure Buzz Lightyear sold out in Europe.

text.p: As desperate parents scoured Britain in vain for Buzz Lightyear, the robot star of the Disney film "Toy Story" was sold at auction on Monday for 175 pounds ($290).
Children have been clamouring for the robot doll in the run-up to Christmas but toy stores across Europe have sold out and warn that fresh stocks cannot be expected until Dec. 28.

The Buzz Lightyear famine sparked an auction by Mencap, the charity for the mentally handicapped. Buyers from Britain and the United States competed in spirited telephone bidding for "the last Buzz in Britain."
It finally went to an anonymous buyer for seven times its retail price.
